x: One of these stations was run by the Wilson brothers and our second-claim member, Cyril Gittins. The course, which was mostly on country roads, was fairly flat for five miles, then , in typical Surrey fashion, the remainder of the lap was rather undulating.
On the same night second-claim member Cyril Gittins was re-elected Chairman of the Southern R.W.A.

Warmest congratulations to our Q.P.H. member, Cyril Gittins, upon being elected President of the Southern Area of the R.W.A. Cyril has also had a spell in the Chair, is a Grade I Timekeeper, and is a regular official at our Battersea Park meetings.
It was good to see John Dunsford and Ron Day getting back to form. The proceedings were presided over by Cyril Gittins, adorned with the Chain and Badge of the President of the S.R.W.A.
